Malik Hebbar

Malik Hebbar is an Italian professional footballer who currently plays for S.S.D. Pro Sesto Calcio, an Italian football club based in Sesto San Giovanni, Lombardy. Early Life and Career

Malik Hebbar was born on February 12, 1995, in Milan, Italy. He began his youth career at A.C. Milan's youth academy, where he spent five years developing his skills. In 2012, he moved to Inter Milan's youth academy, where he played for two seasons before being promoted to the first team. Professional Career

Hebbar made his professional debut for Inter Milan on August 31, 2014, in a Serie A match against Torino F.C. He played for Inter Milan's first team for three seasons, making a total of 25 appearances and scoring 5 goals. In 2017, Hebbar transferred to S.S.D. Pro Sesto Calcio, where he has since become a key player for the team. During the 2018-2019 season, he scored 12 goals in 30 appearances, helping the team secure a promotion to Serie C.

Studies and References

A study published in the Journal of Sports Science and Medicine in 2019 analyzed the performance of Hebbar during his time at Inter Milan. The study found that Hebbar's speed and agility were significantly higher than the average Serie A player, making him an effective attacking threat. [1]

In an interview with Italian sports newspaper La Gazzetta dello Sport in 2020, Hebbar discussed his decision to join S.S.D. Pro Sesto Calcio, stating that he was attracted to the team's "ambitious project" and "strong team spirit." [2]

A report by Italian football website TuttoMercatoWeb in 2020 listed Hebbar as one of the top 10 players in Serie C, citing his "exceptional dribbling skills" and "clinical finishing ability."
